Meds Proficiency.finding: Legacy progression is primarily a per-item barter/purchase unlock ladder. The pinned corpus includes repeated HandoverItem requirements followed by AssortmentUnlock rewards for the target medical item; this is source material, not an acceptable Admiral campaign shape.

Stims Proficiency.finding: Legacy progression is likewise organized around individual stimulant trade unlocks. The pinned locale explicitly frames stable production and repeat purchase as the payoff. Permanent stimulant-catalog expansion is therefore treated as a high-pressure economy surface rather than inherited progression.

reject: generic HandoverItem supply ladders whose principal payoff is unlocking the handed-over item
barter-versus-cash duplicate quest variants for the same item
reward escalation justified only by the market value of the unlocked consumable
generic stimulant-conditioned combat as a standalone Admiral capability milestone because vanilla already owns that defining fantasy
multiple ordinary-field-medicine quests distinguished only by narrative timing when they rely on the same unresolved treatment/recovery mechanic
preserve: bounded specialist medical access as a milestone payoff
productDecision.rationale: Admiral is a capability broker and expeditionary logistics trader. Medical progression must prove field capability and then grant a narrow privilege; it must not recreate 56 item-by-item procurement chores, duplicate a vanilla stimulant-combat competency test, or multiply quest count by assigning separate labels to the same unsupported ordinary-treatment mechanic.

authoredCandidates.purpose: Represent ordinary field stabilization and recovery as one bounded capability milestone rather than separate procurement or narrative-timing quests.
mechanicIntent: meaningful ordinary in-raid treatment or recovery proof
no second quest unless a materially different exact supported mechanic is proven
payoffIntent: one bounded general field-medicine privilege or sample
economyRules: Any renewable offer requires explicit Economy Admiral price, stock and buy-limit approval.
A sample reward must remain small enough that quest completion cannot substitute for routine procurement.
No reward or standing budget is reserved merely because two former working labels were consolidated into one concept.
authoredCandidates.runtimeGate: Deferred. Admit only after exact SPT/EFT-supported ordinary treatment or recovery semantics, vanilla/Artem/Scorpion overlap, numeric reward review and authored EN/RU text. Handover/FIR/use-count/generic survive-extract/stimulant proxies are forbidden.

consolidatedCandidates.reason: Its intended post-contact recovery proof relies on the same unresolved ordinary treatment/recovery authority as Field Medicine Under Pressure. Narrative phase alone is not mechanical differentiation.
Its preparation/stabilization framing is retained as authored context for the canonical field-medicine concept, not as an extra quest slot.

rejectedCandidates.definingFantasy: prove stimulant capability through stimulant-conditioned combat

vanillaAuthority.objective: Eliminate 15 Scavs while under any stimulant effect on Woods
vanillaAuthority.finding: Vanilla already expresses the defining stimulant-in-combat competency fantasy directly. Reducing target count, changing map, changing stimulant list, or adding extraction would be parameter variation rather than a distinct Admiral capability.

dispositionRules: Do not rename and retain the same stimulant-conditioned combat mechanic.
Do not replace it with a filler stimulant-consumption or handover quest.
Do not create a permanent stimulant assortment unlock as compensation.
Do not redistribute any hypothetical reward or standing budget to surviving medical candidates.
A future pharmacology concept may re-enter only with a materially different supported mechanic and a fresh overlap review.

requiredBeforeRuntime: distinct Why / What / Context / Payoff in EN/RU
vanilla plus Artem plus Scorpion semantic-overlap review
Economy Admiral numeric reward and renewable-supply review
